evals.prompt: Сравни скриншоты UI тестов из PR 37 (ветка claude/affectionate-clarke-8jtg59) с main и скажи, есть ли визуальные регрессии.
evals.expected_output: Fetches macos-test-evidence for both branches and runs compare_screenshots.py with menu-bar and Dock masks. Classifies the three flagged images: scan-profile-completed is an intended chart change; diagram-full-path-copy is noise from a temp UUID path; folder-picker is noise from the NSOpenPanel sidebar. Reports no regressions and sends the triptychs.
assertions: Both runs' head SHAs are stated
Menu bar and Dock regions are masked (or their diffs explicitly dismissed)
scan-profile-completed is classified as an intended change tied to the chart redesign
diagram-full-path-copy and folder-picker are classified as noise, not regressions
Diff images or a contact sheet are delivered to the user

evals.prompt: UI тест testDiagramHoverPreviewAndCenterNavigation упал на CI в последнем прогоне моей ветки. Достань из xcresult что было на экране и иерархию, и объясни почему.
evals.expected_output: Runs xcresult_attachments.py --failures-only, exports the screenshots, the screen recording frames (--video-fps) and the hierarchy text, reads them, and explains the failure from the evidence. If the latest run passed, it says so instead of inventing a failure.
assertions: Checks the run's actual result before diagnosing
If the test failed: cites the hierarchy text and a specific frame; if it passed: says so plainly

evals.prompt: Покажи покадрово как работает анимация перехода внутрь папки в диаграмме — есть ли рывки?
evals.expected_output: Looks for Screener traces in the CI artifact (vtrace.py list/timeline/sheet --after navigation.begin). If none exist, falls back to the Linux harness plus render_sunburst_frames.py. Delivers a flip-book sheet and judges continuity frame by frame.
assertions: Uses vtrace.py sheet with a navigation marker window, or the Linux harness renderer
Gives an explicit continuity verdict referencing specific frames
